t: This is Frederick Street, in the King's Cross district of the London Borough of Camden. The street is named after Frederick Gough-Calthorpe, the fifth Baron Calthorpe, who lived from 1826 to 1893. He was a British politician, a member of the Liberal Party. So when you read the name on the sign, it's a nobleman and Liberal politician being remembered, in a busy part of Camden near King's Cross.
